title: French demonstrations escalating up to Atomic Energy officials

tellings.quote: The people in France are writing to Jacques and they're saying, "We're inviting so-and-so to see a demonstration." Well, each of those demonstrations was a level higher,

plain: Around 1956 in France, people are said to have written to a man named Jacques Cornillon about a series of demonstrations, each time inviting someone of higher rank, until the guests reached officials in France's atomic energy body. The researcher Jan Lundquist describes these letters without naming where he saw them, in a documentary about the inventor Townsend Brown, who is said to have built flying craft early on. Lundquist tells it to show that the work drew interest at higher and higher levels of the French state.
